production_recipe.scope: Historical recipe for the approved Kesariya export using Bass Flute 1.2.0. The current 1.2.1 patch intentionally changes the sound; restore the earlier patch to reproduce the original export. Backing, pitch and mastering settings are not baked into the reusable track patch.

production_recipe.backing_pitch_note: This +20-cent correction matched this performance; recheck tuning for each future song/take instead of applying it universally.
production_recipe.master_gain_note: The +6.16 dB gain and fades reproduce this export. For different performances, measure loudness and peaks rather than blindly reusing the gain.
production_recipe.auto_normalize_note: Disable Export projects at full volume for the native render; restore the prior preference after exporting. Do not apply +6.16 dB to an already auto-normalized export.
